items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: Lionel had already made a lot of records with great musicians and including like I said King Cole and some of Benny Goodman's side men, and Teddy Wilson.

ctx.x: First trumpet. He was very instrumental in making that band sound beautiful, and together, because he was an excellent first trumpet player, you know. So that was very, very important to me, although I don't think the records turned out as well as Lionel would have liked them to, and I'm sure they weren't as good as the records he had already made with the more experienced musicians. Did you write some arrangements for Hamp's band when he was at the Terrace, or around that time?
